title: 25 Silly Tumblr Posts That Are Still Iconic Years Later
ai_summary: The article introduces Tumblr as a popular social media site around 2015, similar to Twitter and Reddit, and highlights its iconic status. It presents 25 classic Tumblr posts that remain funny and memorable a decade later, appealing to fans of the site's quirky culture.

title: Meet David Karp, man who dropped out of high school, launched Tumblr at 20, sold it to Yahoo for $1.1 billion, know about his career and journey
ai_summary: David Karp, born July 6, 1986, dropped out of high school and launched Tumblr at 20. He sold the platform to Yahoo for $1.1 billion in 2013. Tumblr hosted over 136 million blogs by 2013.

title: Wikipedia
ai_summary: Tumblr's adult content ban, effective December 2018, prohibited images and videos of sex acts and genitalia, with exceptions for art and medical contexts. The policy faced criticism and a 2022 settlement with NYC's human rights commission, which required algorithm reviews and appeals process changes.

title: Deleted accounts can now be recovered up to 30 days later – @staff on Tumblr
ai_summary: Tumblr now keeps deleted accounts recoverable for 30 days, allowing users to request restoration via support. The change applies only to accounts deleted after the announcement, and usernames and emails remain unavailable for 30 days. Tumblr plans to simplify restoration with a single-click button.
